scenes.narration: Cậu bé ngồi vẽ, chờ tin cha từ biển xa chưa trở lại.
scenes.narration_en: The boy sits drawing, waiting for news of his father from the distant sea who hasn't returned yet.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot. A Vietnamese elementary school boy sitting at a wooden desk in a dimly lit room filled with dust motes dancing in moonlight. He holds a pencil, focused on paper. Background shows worn walls and a photo of a fisherman father.

scenes.narration: Bút màu đỏ là máu của cha cậu, bay lượn trên giấy trắng.
scenes.narration_en: The red paint is his father's blood, floating across the white paper.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic close-up. The boy's small hand coloring a boat shape with intense emotion using bright red marker on notebook paper. Soft warm light highlights dust in air.

scenes.narration: Cậu tưởng tượng cha mình đang lái con tàu màu đỏ trên sóng.
scenes.narration_en: He imagines his father steering the red boat on waves.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot. The boy's face illuminated by window light, eyes closed imagining vividly. In front of him is a drawing emerging showing a large fishing boat and ocean.

scenes.narration: Điện thoại reo vang, tin nhắn báo cha đã về an toàn bến bờ.
scenes.narration_en: The phone rings; the text message reports his father has safely returned to shore.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot. The boy jumps up from chair holding glowing smartphone with both hands in excitement. Room suddenly filled with warm golden sunlight streaming through window.

scenes.narration: Cậu chạy ra cổng, tay ôm bức tranh hoàn thành đầy nước mắt.
scenes.narration_en: He runs to the gate hugging his completed painting which is full of tears.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot. The boy running outside a modest Vietnamese house towards camera holding up finished artwork showing red boat under yellow sun.

scenes.narration: Cha ôm con, bức tranh đỏ rực rỡ giữa nắng chiều vàng óng.
scenes.narration_en: Father hugs son; the painting shines bright amidst golden evening sunlight.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot. Father and son embracing warmly in doorway. Boy holds up drawing showing father on boat under warm sunset sky with village houses behind.
